evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: On CL-bench Life, a benchmark of such real-life context learning, frontier LLMs solve fewer than one task in five.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: On all 405 tasks with four frontier LLMs, QERA attains the highest solving rate on every LLM (21.0% on average, against 18.2% for the strongest of three inference-time baselines and 14.6% for direct answering) and leads every baseline significantly when pooled across LLMs, while using fewer tokens than PSCI and 4-5% of the tokens of Ctx2Skill.
